landing.heroSubtitle: PulseTask strips away clutter so you can focus on getting things done. Intuitive natural language parsing, interactive calendar, built-in Pomodoro, and seamless Persian & English support.
landing.feature1Desc: Type 'Design wireframes tomorrow at 5pm p1' and PulseTask automatically sets your dates, times, and priorities.
landing.feature2Desc: Full bidirectional RTL & LTR support with Shamsi (Jalali) and Gregorian calendars and Vazirmatn typography.
landing.feature3Desc: Connect your tasks to 25-minute deep work intervals with audio alerts and desktop notifications.
